links.to_node: I prevent my colleague's server system upgrade.
I prevent the server system upgrade from occurring.
The company's server system remains at its current performance level without the slight improvement in data processing speed.
The company's operations experience a temporary halt due to the scheduled maintenance by the server provider.
The temporary halt in operations happens without the additional downtime that might have been caused by the upgrade process.
My colleague is unable to implement the planned server upgrade.
